d: "Laica" is half dating sim, half survival horror, where you live with a girl on a space station that's being eaten alive. You wake up in HOME, a habitat drifting somewhere in space, and the only other person there is a girl called Laica who has been living in it entirely alone. So you do ordinary things. Share meals. Put music on. Go on small adventures around the station. Float together in zero gravity because there is nothing stopping you. Then you go outside. The world beyond HOME is dark and there are grotesque things moving in it, and the game turns into first-person survival horror for as long as you are out there. You come back, and it is another ordinary day with Laica. That rhythm is the whole design, and the reason it works is that something is quietly eating away at space itself, so the calm half has a clock running under it.
